contexts.name: Synthesis HTTP Surface
contexts.description: The ElevenLabs-shaped HTTP door: /v1/text-to-speech (buffered, streaming, with-timestamps), /v1/speak, models and the app wiring that mounts every router. Owns the one error voice (sanitized request-id 500s), CORS, runtime config and the def/async handler-mode discipline.

contexts.name: Concurrency Engine & Admission
contexts.description: The bounded pool of independent Pocket TTS model instances: admission permits, deadlines, drain/abandon, worker supervision and the single-flight result cache. Every job's future is always resolved and every permit released in a finally.

contexts.name: Engine Plane & Alternate Mouths
contexts.description: Which mouth speaks: the engine plane's capability table, the Piper second engine for languages Pocket TTS cannot say, and the one-load stem exporter. Covers polyglot turns, zero-gap concatenation and long-form stability.

contexts.name: Voice & Character Registry
contexts.description: Characters, Voices and the emotion scale on disk: the registry's atomic writes, cross-process mutation locks, builtin-collision rules, rollback on a failed write and emotion-tagged segment parsing.

contexts.name: Emotion Algebra & Prosody
contexts.description: Does an emotion travel? The shared emotion basis (averaged residuals, per-emotion coherence, alpha), prosody measurement, fallback demand telemetry, and the operator tools that derive, A/B and backfill emotion slots.

contexts.name: Ingest Pipeline
contexts.description: Character-from-recording: scan, review, commit. Job lifecycle, cancellation, drain, per-job budgets, cross-process exclusion and the measured truth a clone reports about itself.

contexts.name: Link Ingest
contexts.description: A pasted link becomes the same audio file a drop would have been: URL probing, external fetch limits and the sovereignty rules on what may be pulled.

contexts.name: Diarization, Casting & Voiceprints
contexts.description: Who spoke when, locally: speaker diarization, the streaming voice-activity gate, one speaker embedding and the is-this-the-same-voice question that casting and auditions rest on.

contexts.name: Speech-to-Text & Verification
contexts.description: The ear the service never had: local transcription, plus the pure half of verified speech - did the audio actually say the words?

contexts.name: Character Packs
contexts.description: Portable, integrity-checked character bundles: pack origin provenance and the safety rules for importing someone else's voice.

contexts.name: Scene Vision Pipeline
contexts.description: The studio's eyes, locally: scene segmentation and frame capture, then Qwen vision describing what is on the screen scene by scene.

contexts.name: Silent-Video Voiceover
contexts.description: Scenes in, a narrated video out: the voiceover job doors, registry and phase thread, and the media/frame assets a client polls.

contexts.name: Video Re-voice
contexts.description: Replace the speech in an analyzed video line by line: the stateless door, the phase thread and the fit ladder that makes a new line land in the old gap.

contexts.name: Audible Docs Narration
contexts.description: Any page becomes a segmented narration plan - the server half of the narration dock.

contexts.name: Media Job Registry
contexts.description: The job bookkeeping the voiceover and re-voice pipelines share: the JOBS dict, its lock, held admission permits released in a finally, first-writer-wins terminal state, the deferred work-dir reap and the public projection. Extracted once both pipelines had grown the same ~120 lines and the same defect had to be fixed in each by hand.

contexts.name: Conversational Agent Socket
contexts.description: The ElevenLabs Agents WebSocket served locally: who the agent is and what it says next (dialog), the one-shot LLM completion seam (brain) and the protocol conformance around them.

contexts.name: Gym Replay & Grading
contexts.description: A recorded call replayed as a deterministic test: what a conversation left behind (two aligned WAVs and a transcript), the replay driver, and the diff primitive the ledger gates on.

contexts.name: Takes, Reviews & Lineage
contexts.description: Persisted renders behind public pages: shared takes, review sets with first-writer-wins picks, and the lineage a take carries back to its score.

contexts.name: Speech as a Build Artifact
contexts.description: The identity function and the durable store that turn a render into a reproducible build, plus the promise the service measures itself against.

contexts.name: Direction Telemetry
contexts.description: What humans CHANGE when they re-perform a take - the signal that tells the product where its defaults are wrong.

contexts.name: API Keys & Auth
contexts.description: Central API-key enforcement for every router, plus issue / rotate / revoke with copy-once secrets and scoped capabilities.

contexts.name: Rate Limiting & Error Reporting
contexts.description: The one per-IP limiter every public compute surface shares (shared across replicas), and error reporting that stays OFF until an operator names a DSN.

contexts.name: Load Testing & Workloads
contexts.description: Ramp load-testing to find the concurrency cap before critical degradation, and the traffic shape (when requests arrive, what they say) the harness replays.

contexts.name: Benchmark Harness
contexts.description: The Graviton/ARM benchmark scripts and the AWS runner behind the published cost-per-hour numbers.

contexts.name: Replicas & Deployment Compiler
contexts.description: The real scaling story for a GIL-bound model: N single-worker processes behind SO_REUSEPORT, and the compiler that writes the artifact's own topology from a measurement.

contexts.name: Packaging & Host Deployment
contexts.description: Container image, systemd unit, one-click AWS bootstrap, CloudFormation and rollback - how the service reaches a host.

contexts.name: Kubernetes Helm Chart
contexts.description: The Helm chart: deployment, service, PVC, secret, HPA and the KEDA scaled object that scales on real queue depth.

contexts.name: Sealed Appliance & Certification
contexts.description: What this artifact IS, as a checkable fact: the sealed-appliance attestation, certify-your-box hardware certification and the airgap installer.

contexts.name: CI Pipelines
contexts.description: GitHub Actions: the live CI plus the sealed-build, audio-drift and performance-ledger workflow templates operators enable per deployment.

contexts.name: MCP Server
contexts.description: The Model Context Protocol server that hands agents Gravitone's tools: manifest, RPC framing, call routing and config.

contexts.name: Build & Provisioning Scripts
contexts.description: Node-side operator scripts: the reproducible build entry point and prove-keys, which proves a minted key actually works.

contexts.name: Product Documentation
contexts.description: Operator- and buyer-facing docs: the ElevenLabs switch guide, deploy rehearsal, plus the repo and service READMEs.

contexts.name: Speech & Voice Routes
contexts.description: Browser-facing proxies for synthesis: /api/speak (buffered + stream), /api/tts, /api/stt and the voice listing.

contexts.name: Character & Corpus Routes
contexts.description: Character CRUD, corpus clips, emotion slots and derive, pack export and import - the studio's data door.

contexts.name: Ingest Routes
contexts.description: The clone wizard's server half: scan, scan-url, link-probe, per-job polling, speaker preview, casting, audition, stems, scene and commit.

contexts.name: Key Routes & Well-Known
contexts.description: Key minting, revocation, deployment manifests, live probes and the /.well-known/gravitone.json identity document.

contexts.name: Gym & ConvAI Routes
contexts.description: Signed-url handshake for live calls, agent listing, recordings with per-track audio, care notes, replay and compare.

contexts.name: Video Routes
contexts.description: Voiceover and re-voice job doors plus their frame and media assets, and the narration plan fetch.

contexts.name: Takes & Reviews Routes
contexts.description: Persisting and serving shared takes, review sets and the first-writer-wins pick.

contexts.name: Ops & Feedback Routes
contexts.description: Health, metrics, performance and the rate-limited feedback intake behind the feedback dock.

contexts.name: Clone Wizard State Machine
contexts.description: The wizard's brain: the stage machine, upload limits and probing, job polling with stall detection, backpressure, reset and the vault receipt.

contexts.name: Casting & Audition State
contexts.description: Client-side casting: speaker selection, audition playback, corpus and scene derivation, clip transport.

contexts.name: Wizard Shell & Upload Stage
contexts.description: Where a clone starts: the page shell, header, step rail, notices, mode panel, drop/link doors and the waveform lab plus scan report while it thinks.

contexts.name: Speaker Casting UI
contexts.description: The casting stage: speaker rows with previews, the cast panel and the casting-in-progress state.

contexts.name: Segment Review & Commit
contexts.description: The review round: segment board and rows, audition panel, take list, ledger, the commit panel and every completion / expiry outcome.

contexts.name: Character Roster
contexts.description: The roster table: coverage bars, signal chips, tag editing, bulk actions, cloning, collision prompts and the empty state.

contexts.name: Character Detail & Corpus
contexts.description: One character's page: header, corpus clips with deletion and rebuild, cast export and the API panel that shows how to call this voice.

contexts.name: Emotion Rack & Audition
contexts.description: The emotion rack: slot rows and actions, shadow rows for derived slots, donor picking, the palette panel, blind audition tiles and the guided recorder that fills a slot.

contexts.name: Profile & My Voices
contexts.description: The signed-in surface: the voices that are mine, their sign-off badges and the rows that own them.

contexts.name: Consent Sign-off Flow
contexts.description: The public /s/[voiceId] page a voice owner signs: the phrase recorder, the terms form, the gate that decides whether a sign-off counts, and the outcome.

contexts.name: Playground Console & Composer
contexts.description: The console shell: the character rail, compose bay, notices, render status and the composer state that survives a reload.

contexts.name: Score Editor
contexts.description: The score: markup, lanes, placement, the inspector, the director and the preview run - where direction is written before it is spoken.

contexts.name: Emotion Picker & Wheel
contexts.description: Choosing an emotion: chips, the spoke wheel with keyboard control, and the A/B comparison that proves the choice changed something.

contexts.name: Takes, Punch-in & Playback
contexts.description: What came out: the take log and cards, take codes, the timeline, punch-in lanes for re-recording a span, sharing and the audio player.

contexts.name: Playground Engine Seam
contexts.description: Which engine renders this line, what it will cost, and how generation is driven - the playground's side of the engine plane.

contexts.name: Live Call Client
contexts.description: The browser half of a live agent call: the mic worklet, PCM conversion, the call socket, the stage, controls and the running transcript.

contexts.name: Video Dub & Reel
contexts.description: The video round inside the playground: the reel door, the marquee with its playhead, narrate and re-voice lanes, and the dub sheet where a line's takes live.

contexts.name: Gym Forensics UI
contexts.description: The gym page as a forensic timeline: sessions, diagnosis, care, the replay drawer, per-turn inspection and track seeking.

contexts.name: Keys Console
contexts.description: The key ledger: minting with a copy-once reveal, scope chips, revocation with honest rollback copy, agent blocks, the migration kit, attestation and the proving sweep.

contexts.name: Ops Transparency
contexts.description: What the box is doing right now: live tiles fed by the metrics poll, formatted for a human rather than a scraper.

contexts.name: Benchmarks & Local Engine
contexts.description: The published leaderboard, the cost bar, the planner and the local-engine panel that lets a visitor check the claim on their own hardware.

contexts.name: Shared Take & Review Pages
contexts.description: The public artifacts: /t/[id] take pages with score readout, lineage, re-perform and embed, and /r/[id] review pages where a client picks.

contexts.name: App Shell & Navigation
contexts.description: The frame every page sits in: root layout, app frame, mobile nav, user menu, global CSS and the edge middleware that fronts them.

contexts.name: UI Primitives & Tokens
contexts.description: The Signal design language in code: primitives, tokens, regions and the ErrorBanner every honest failure surface uses.

contexts.name: Audio Transport Components
contexts.description: Shared listening surfaces: the audio bus and its analysis graph, tracks with playheads and seeking, the take player, the equalizer and the transport hook.

contexts.name: Narration Dock
contexts.description: The product narrating itself: the dock, its narrator selection, highlight sync, synthesis, remote clips and transport - plus the baked narration the page ships with.

contexts.name: Feedback Dock
contexts.description: The in-product feedback door and its panel, rate-limited on the way out.

contexts.name: Emotion Glyph Art
contexts.description: Emotion as a picture: generated glyphs, the emotion icon set, the art component and the rendered emotion plates.

contexts.name: Landing Page & Hero
contexts.description: The front door: the landing page, the hero mic demo, the studio-dark treatment, the section rail and the entrance motion that carries them.

contexts.name: Feature Signal Illustrations
contexts.description: The animated illustrations that carry each feature's story - the preview set, its geometry helpers, the feature grid and spotlight.

contexts.name: Pricing
contexts.description: The pricing section: the bills animation and its odometer, the easing and timeline behind them, and the math that keeps the comparison honest.

contexts.name: API Fetch & Backend Seam
contexts.description: How the web talks to the service: apiFetch's throwDetail/apiJson contract, the backend base URL, service headers, the engine seam and engine probe.

contexts.name: Auth & Identity
contexts.description: Firebase auth, the useAuth provider, ID-token handling, key minting from the browser and the consent record a clone requires.

contexts.name: Local Persistence Stores
contexts.description: What survives a reload: the playground IndexedDB, the composer and take stores, server-side take reads and the voice vault.

contexts.name: Audio & Content Utilities
contexts.description: WAV encoding, format negotiation, peak extraction, emotion scripts and vocabulary, slugs and marketing content.

contexts.name: Shared React Hooks
contexts.description: The hooks every surface is supposed to reuse: useMounted, useCopyFeedback, the single health poll, the metrics poll and still-aware motion.

contexts.name: Observability & Security Headers
contexts.description: Sentry wiring on every runtime, the instrumentation hooks and the security headers the app sends.

contexts.name: Web Build & Test Config
contexts.description: Next, TypeScript, PostCSS and Vitest configuration plus the global test setup.
